classification_notes: This season was extracted from the downloaded Manchester United Football Club Limited Companies House filing because that is the raw statement available in the Manchester United folder for the pre-plc gap years. The turnover note discloses Commercial, Broadcasting and Matchday directly, but the commercial line is materially narrower than the broader plc commercial segment used in later seasons.
women_team_treatment_notes: Women's team revenue is not separately disclosed in the source used here.
non_football_revenue_notes: The turnover note states turnover excludes transfer fees and VAT. No separate non-football revenue adjustment was identified within the club-limited turnover note used here.
source_document: Manchester United Football Club Limited annual report and financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2013
notes: Scanned PDF extraction. Debt is not disclosed as a single company net-debt line, so net debt has been estimated as fellow-subsidiary senior secured notes plus secured term loan less company cash at bank and in hand.
